title: centigrade — newcomer

sentences.sentence: ...daytime temperatures of up to forty degrees centigrade.
sentences.translation: …高达40摄氏度的日间气温。

sentences.sentence: Would you rather be an alchemist or a chemist?
sentences.translation: 那么，你想做一个炼金术士，还是一个化学家呢？

sentences.sentence: Our industrialists are transforming sand and oil into ever smaller and more intricate machines, a form of alchemy more wondrous than anything any alchemist ever dreamed of.
sentences.translation: 工业家正在将沙和石油转化为更为小巧、更为复杂的机器，这是一种连历史中的炼金术士做梦都无法想到的魔法。

最佳编程；最佳程序设计

sentences.sentence: If we treat good diet as a cornerstone of optimum nutrition and do regular exercise, we will have much bigger chance to do and enjoy something else.
sentences.translation: 如果我们处理好饮食的一个基础就是最佳营养和做适量运动，我们将有更大的机会和享受做别的事情。

sentences.sentence: a garage mechanic
sentences.translation: 汽车修理厂的技工

phrases.translation: 对…应负责任；应该为某事负责任

sentences.sentence: Don’t blame me – it’s not my fault.
sentences.translation: 别来怪我——又不是我的错。

sentences.sentence: I blame his mother. She does everything for him.
sentences.translation: 怪他母亲不好，她什么事都要为他做。

sentences.sentence: The doctor will be here presently.
sentences.translation: 医生一会儿就到。

sentences.sentence: Presently, I fell asleep.
sentences.translation: 一会儿我就睡着了。

sentences.sentence: There are some objections to the proposal to reelect the chairman.
sentences.translation: 对重新选举董事长的提议有人持反对意见。

sentences.sentence: And proxy advisory firm Institutional Shareholder Services recently recommended that News Corp shareholders not reelect several board members, including chairman and CEO Rupert Murdoch, and his sons.
sentences.translation: 同时，代理顾问服务公司ISS建议新闻集团股东在今年的股东大会上改选几名董事会成员，包括新闻集团董事长兼CEO鲁伯特•默多克和他的两个儿子。

phrases.translation: 仓库管理，仓储管理；仓库治理

sentences.sentence: The large warehouse backs on to the river.
sentences.translation: 这大货栈背朝江河。

sentences.sentence: I stored up the old furniture in the warehouse.
sentences.translation: 我把旧家具存放在了仓库里。

sentences.sentence: Bales of cotton were piled up in the warehouse.
sentences.translation: 大捆大捆的棉花堆积在仓库里。

sentences.sentence: If the Europeans did not reduce subsidies, a trade war would ensue.
sentences.translation: 如果欧洲不减少补贴，贸易战将随即爆发。

sentences.sentence: a bunch of cherries
sentences.translation: 一串樱桃

sentences.sentence: cherry pie
sentences.translation: 樱桃馅饼

translations.translation: 有历史意义的, 历史的

phrases.translation: 古迹；历史遗迹；历史地段

sentences.sentence: a historic meeting of world leaders
sentences.translation: 具有历史意义的世界领导人会议

sentences.sentence: ‘It is a historic moment ,’ he told journalists.
sentences.translation: “那是历史性的一刻。”他告诉新闻记者。

phrases.translation: 尼斯湖水怪（相传在尼斯湖出现的一种巨型怪兽）

sentences.sentence: the remains of a prehistoric monster
sentences.translation: 史前怪兽的遗骸

sentences.sentence: the search for the Loch Ness Monster
sentences.translation: 对内斯湖水怪的搜寻

sentences.sentence: The stomach contained a fish hook, bits of digested fish skull and some tapeworm.
sentences.translation: 胃里面有个钓鱼钩，少量消化之后残留的鱼骸和一些绦虫。

sentences.sentence: The plan is to allow the tapeworm to live in you for up to 10 weeks, and then take prescribed medication to kill it.
sentences.translation: 这个计划是让绦虫在你体内存活至少10个礼拜，然后用指定的药物来杀灭它。

sentences.sentence: If you swallow a tapeworm in a cyst and let it grow inside you, dieters claim the worm will help you lose 1-2 pounds a week.
sentences.translation: 节食者声称，如果绦虫进入你的囊肿中并在你体内成长，该蠕虫将帮助你每周减轻1-2磅。

sentences.sentence: Many sickly ones have there always been among those who muse, and languish for God; violently they hate the discerning ones, and the latest of virtues, which is uprightness.
sentences.translation: 在那些无声祷告、为神憔悴的人群中间，总混有许多病态的家伙；他们极端憎恨有洞察力的人，憎恨那些最近得道、坦诚的人。

sentences.sentence: characters from classical mythology
sentences.translation: 古典神话中的人物

sentences.sentence: I must report your lateness to the teacher.
sentences.translation: 我必须报告老师你迟到了。

sentences.sentence: I remember that rich bass voice hanging in the night air, making some elaborate operatic point despite the lateness of the hour - and the train.
sentences.translation: 尽管那次时间已经很晚，再加上火车的隆隆声，我还记得那饱满的低音弥漫在夜空之中，详尽地阐述他关于歌剧的看法 。

sentences.sentence: The guesthouse in Nanshao was the most pleasant we have come across, run by a welcoming Miao family who despite the lateness of the hour gave us hot water for our feet and hot food for our bellies.
sentences.translation: 南哨的旅馆是我们遇到的最友善的旅馆，由一家好客的苗族人经营。 尽管那天已经很晚，主人还是为我们的双脚提供了热水，为我们的肚子提供了热饭。

sentences.sentence: The dollar has fallen in value amid rumors of weakness in the US economy.
sentences.translation: 在一片美国经济疲软的传言中，美元贬值了。

sentences.sentence: Demonstrators ripped up the national flag amid shouts of ‘Death to the tyrants!’
sentences.translation: 示威者在“处死暴君！”的叫喊声中将国旗撕得粉碎。

sentences.sentence: Plato describes in “Phaedrus,” in mythological language, why and how the souls take their birth upon this plane, either as human or animal.
sentences.translation: 柏拉图在他的“斐德罗篇”中，以神话的语言描述了灵魂为何和怎样在人类的层面上或动物的层面上产生。

sentences.sentence: This genre painting became very popular in the Netherlands and the north in general, because it was opposed to the mythological painting of Italy.
sentences.translation: 这种绘画类型在荷兰乃至整个北部变得流行起来，因为它是对意大利神话题材绘画的反叛。

sentences.sentence: While Henry’s essay is of course speculative, he nevertheless takes on an authoritative tone, and makes copious references to ancient mythological texts, as well as Zecharia Sitchin ’s works.
sentences.translation: 尽管亨利的文章当然是推测性的，他依然采用一种权威式的口吻，并参考了大量的古代神话文本和撒迦利亚? 西琴的作品。

phrases.translation: 样机试验；原型试验；实船实验

sentences.sentence: But how do you come up with the architecture for this evolutionary prototype?
sentences.translation: 但是你将如何为这个进化的原型提出系统的架构呢？

sentences.sentence: But it may be an alternative when you have to finish a prototype in limited time.
sentences.translation: 但是，当您需要在有限的时间内完成一个原型时，这也许是一种选择。

sentences.sentence: a special award for the most promising newcomer
sentences.translation: 颁发给最有前途新人的特殊奖项

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 255 单元

centigrade
音标：英 /'sentɪgreɪd/  美 /'sɛntɪɡred/
adj. 摄氏的
短语：degree centigrade — 摄氏温度；百分度
例句：...daytime temperatures of up to forty degrees centigrade.
…高达40摄氏度的日间气温。

alchemist
音标：英 /'ælkɪmɪst/  美 /'ælkəmɪst/
n. 炼金术士
例句：Would you rather be an alchemist or a chemist?
那么，你想做一个炼金术士，还是一个化学家呢？
例句：Our industrialists are transforming sand and oil into ever smaller and more intricate machines, a form of alchemy more wondrous than anything any alchemist ever dreamed of.
工业家正在将沙和石油转化为更为小巧、更为复杂的机器，这是一种连历史中的炼金术士做梦都无法想到的魔法。

optimum
音标：英 /'ɒptɪməm/  美 /'ɑptəməm/
n&a. 最适宜(的)
短语：optimum design — 最佳设计，最优设计
短语：optimum condition — 最适条件；最佳工况
短语：optimum solution — 最佳（优）解
短语：optimum control — 最优控制；最佳控制
短语：global optimum — 总体最优值
短语：local optimum — 局部最优
短语：optimum value — 最佳值；最优值
短语：optimum performance — 最佳操作特性
短语：optimum temperature — 最适温度；最佳温度
短语：optimum structure — n. 最佳结构
短语：optimum matching — 最佳匹配
短语：optimum seeking method — 优选法
短语：optimum efficiency — 最佳效率
短语：pareto optimum — 帕累托最优
短语：optimum size — 最佳规模；最适规模；最佳尺寸；最佳粒度
短语：optimum programming — 最佳编程；最佳程序设计
短语：optimum moisture — 最佳水分
短语：optimum output — 最佳输出
短语：optimum density — 最佳密度；最适密度
短语：optimum balance — n. 最佳的平衡，最适均衡
例句：If we treat good diet as a cornerstone of optimum nutrition and do regular exercise, we will have much bigger chance to do and enjoy something else.
如果我们处理好饮食的一个基础就是最佳营养和做适量运动，我们将有更大的机会和享受做别的事情。

mechanic
音标：英 /mɪ'kænɪk/  美 /mə'kænɪk/
n. 技工
短语：mechanic design — 机械设计
短语：car mechanic — n. 汽车修理师
例句：a garage mechanic
汽车修理厂的技工

blame
音标：英 /bleɪm/  美 /blem/
n&vt. 责备
短语：blame for — 责备；因……责备
短语：take the blame — 承担过错
短语：put the blame on — 归咎于…
短语：be to blame for — 对…应负责任；应该为某事负责任
短语：bear the blame — 承担责任
例句：Don’t blame me – it’s not my fault.
别来怪我——又不是我的错。
例句：I blame his mother. She does everything for him.
怪他母亲不好，她什么事都要为他做。

presently
音标：英 /'prez(ə)ntlɪ/  美 /'prɛzntli/
adv. 目前, 不久
例句：The doctor will be here presently.
医生一会儿就到。
例句：Presently, I fell asleep.
一会儿我就睡着了。

reelect
音标：英 /,ri:i'lekt/  美 /,riə'lɛkt/
v. 重选, 改选
例句：There are some objections to the proposal to reelect the chairman.
对重新选举董事长的提议有人持反对意见。
例句：And proxy advisory firm Institutional Shareholder Services recently recommended that News Corp shareholders not reelect several board members, including chairman and CEO Rupert Murdoch, and his sons.
同时，代理顾问服务公司ISS建议新闻集团股东在今年的股东大会上改选几名董事会成员，包括新闻集团董事长兼CEO鲁伯特•默多克和他的两个儿子。

warehouse
音标：英 /'weəhaʊs/  美 /'wɛrhaʊs/
n. 仓库，货栈
短语：data warehouse — 数据仓库
短语：warehouse management — 仓库管理，仓储管理；仓库治理
短语：bonded warehouse — 保税仓库，关栈
短语：warehouse to warehouse — 仓至仓
短语：warehouse space — 仓库容积
短语：warehouse receipt — 仓单；栈单；仓库收据
短语：warehouse to warehouse clause — 仓库至仓库条款
短语：warehouse supervisor — 仓库主管；仓库管理人
短语：warehouse keeper — 仓库管理员
短语：warehouse stock — 仓库库存
短语：automatic warehouse — 自动仓库；自动化仓库
例句：The large warehouse backs on to the river.
这大货栈背朝江河。
例句：I stored up the old furniture in the warehouse.
我把旧家具存放在了仓库里。
例句：Bales of cotton were piled up in the warehouse.
大捆大捆的棉花堆积在仓库里。

ensue
音标：英 /ɪn'sjuː; en-/  美 /ɪn'su/
v. 接着发生，接踵而来
例句：If the Europeans did not reduce subsidies, a trade war would ensue.
如果欧洲不减少补贴，贸易战将随即爆发。

cherry
音标：英 /'tʃerɪ/  美 /'tʃɛri/
n. 樱桃
短语：black cherry — 黑樱桃；野樱桃
短语：cherry tree — 樱桃树
短语：cherry blossom — 樱花
短语：cherry tomato — 樱桃番茄
短语：cherry red — 樱桃红；桃红色
短语：wild cherry — 野黑樱桃
短语：sweet cherry — 甜樱桃；欧洲甜樱桃
短语：oriental cherry — 樱花
短语：cherry plum — [植]樱桃李
短语：barbados cherry — 巴贝多樱桃（等于acerola）
短语：sour cherry — 酸樱桃；欧洲酸樱桃
短语：ground cherry — 地樱桃，醋栗；鹅莓
例句：a bunch of cherries
一串樱桃
例句：cherry pie
樱桃馅饼

historic
音标：英 /hɪ'stɒrɪk/  美 /hɪ'stɔrɪk/
adj. 有历史意义的, 历史的
短语：historic site — 古迹；历史遗迹；历史地段
短语：historic monument — 历史碑石
例句：a historic meeting of world leaders
具有历史意义的世界领导人会议
例句：‘It is a historic moment ,’ he told journalists.
“那是历史性的一刻。”他告诉新闻记者。

monster
音标：英 /'mɒnstə/  美 /'mɑnstɚ/
n. 怪物
短语：loch ness monster — 尼斯湖水怪（相传在尼斯湖出现的一种巨型怪兽）
短语：green-eyed monster — n. 嫉妒
短语：sea monster — n. 海怪
例句：the remains of a prehistoric monster
史前怪兽的遗骸
例句：the search for the Loch Ness Monster
对内斯湖水怪的搜寻

tapeworm
音标：英 /'teɪpwɜːm/  美 /'tepwɝm/
n. [动]绦虫
例句：The stomach contained a fish hook, bits of digested fish skull and some tapeworm.
胃里面有个钓鱼钩，少量消化之后残留的鱼骸和一些绦虫。
例句：The plan is to allow the tapeworm to live in you for up to 10 weeks, and then take prescribed medication to kill it.
这个计划是让绦虫在你体内存活至少10个礼拜，然后用指定的药物来杀灭它。
例句：If you swallow a tapeworm in a cyst and let it grow inside you, dieters claim the worm will help you lose 1-2 pounds a week.
节食者声称，如果绦虫进入你的囊肿中并在你体内成长，该蠕虫将帮助你每周减轻1-2磅。

languish
音标：英 /'læŋgwɪʃ/  美 /'læŋɡwɪʃ/
v. 憔悴, 凋萎
例句：Many sickly ones have there always been among those who muse, and languish for God; violently they hate the discerning ones, and the latest of virtues, which is uprightness.
在那些无声祷告、为神憔悴的人群中间，总混有许多病态的家伙；他们极端憎恨有洞察力的人，憎恨那些最近得道、坦诚的人。

mythology
音标：英 /mɪ'θɒlədʒɪ/  美 /mɪ'θɑlədʒi/
n. 神话
例句：characters from classical mythology
古典神话中的人物

lateness
n. 迟, 晚
例句：I must report your lateness to the teacher.
我必须报告老师你迟到了。
例句：I remember that rich bass voice hanging in the night air, making some elaborate operatic point despite the lateness of the hour - and the train.
尽管那次时间已经很晚，再加上火车的隆隆声，我还记得那饱满的低音弥漫在夜空之中，详尽地阐述他关于歌剧的看法 。
例句：The guesthouse in Nanshao was the most pleasant we have come across, run by a welcoming Miao family who despite the lateness of the hour gave us hot water for our feet and hot food for our bellies.
南哨的旅馆是我们遇到的最友善的旅馆，由一家好客的苗族人经营。 尽管那天已经很晚，主人还是为我们的双脚提供了热水，为我们的肚子提供了热饭。

amid
音标：英 /ə'mɪd/  美 /ə'mɪd/
prep. 在中
例句：The dollar has fallen in value amid rumors of weakness in the US economy.
在一片美国经济疲软的传言中，美元贬值了。
例句：Demonstrators ripped up the national flag amid shouts of ‘Death to the tyrants!’
示威者在“处死暴君！”的叫喊声中将国旗撕得粉碎。

mythological
音标：英 /mɪθə'lɒdʒɪk(ə)l/  美 /,mɪθə'lɑdʒɪkl/
adj. 神话(学)的
例句：Plato describes in “Phaedrus,” in mythological language, why and how the souls take their birth upon this plane, either as human or animal.
柏拉图在他的“斐德罗篇”中，以神话的语言描述了灵魂为何和怎样在人类的层面上或动物的层面上产生。
例句：This genre painting became very popular in the Netherlands and the north in general, because it was opposed to the mythological painting of Italy.
这种绘画类型在荷兰乃至整个北部变得流行起来，因为它是对意大利神话题材绘画的反叛。
例句：While Henry’s essay is of course speculative, he nevertheless takes on an authoritative tone, and makes copious references to ancient mythological texts, as well as Zecharia Sitchin ’s works.
尽管亨利的文章当然是推测性的，他依然采用一种权威式的口吻，并参考了大量的古代神话文本和撒迦利亚? 西琴的作品。

prototype
音标：英 /'prəʊtətaɪp/  美 /'protə'taɪp/
n. 原型
短语：prototype system — [计]原型系统
短语：prototype theory — 原型理论；原型说
短语：prototype test — 原型测试，样机试验
短语：prototype machine — 样机；原型电机
短语：prototype development — 原型开发；原型机研制
短语：prototype testing — 样机试验；原型试验；实船实验
短语：prototype stage — 原型阶段
短语：function prototype — 函数原型
例句：But how do you come up with the architecture for this evolutionary prototype?
但是你将如何为这个进化的原型提出系统的架构呢？
例句：But it may be an alternative when you have to finish a prototype in limited time.
但是，当您需要在有限的时间内完成一个原型时，这也许是一种选择。

newcomer
音标：英 /'njuːkʌmə/  美 /'nukʌmɚ/
n. 新来的人；移民
例句：a special award for the most promising newcomer
颁发给最有前途新人的特殊奖项
